opening.argument: The video shows runners passing under a start banner, then closes with a youth mental-health appeal and an invitation to register. RBC Race for the Kids and CHEO Foundation branding identify the event, while the description states that money raised for each race is contributed to charities supporting children and youth. The sign-up invitation is presented as participation in that running event and its stated charitable purpose. Nothing in the supplied material supports a promise of investment returns or a request for credentials.

citations.quote: the money raised for each RBC Race for the Kids event is contributed to charities all over the world that support children and youth.
